feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND ("Review"[Publication Type]) AND (overview OR introduction OR "current understanding" OR primer OR basics)

drug.title: Cerebral amyloid-β burden and white matter injury: associations, clues for underlying mechanisms, and implication on cognitive trajectory after lecanemab therapy.
drug.zh: 仑卡奈单抗疗效受基线白质损伤影响，Aβ负荷或经特定通路加剧白质损伤。

drug.title: A Metabolomics-Based Strategy for Identifying Endogenous Inhibitors of IAPP Aggregation.
drug.zh: 代谢组学揭示内源性代谢物可抑制IAPP聚集，为T2DM治疗提供新靶点。

drug.title: Donanemab for early symptomatic AD in the UK-indicated population: safety and efficacy in those who are non-carriers or heterozygous for APOE ε4.
drug.zh: 英国适用人群中，多奈单抗对APOE ε4非携带者及杂合子早期症状性AD患者安全有效。

drug.title: Anti-Amyloid Drugs: Integrated Clinical Pathways for Treating Older Patients with Frailty and Dementia.
drug.zh: 抗淀粉样蛋白疗法对衰弱痴呆老人疗效有限，应将其作为分层维度而非排除标准。

drug.title: Tau-targeting pharmacological strategies in neurodegenerative disease.
drug.zh: 靶向病理tau而非全面降低tau，是tau蛋白病治疗策略优化的关键方向。

drug.title: Comparison of double-blind and open-label decline rates in lecanemab and donanemab trials in Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: 双盲与开放标签阶段斜率差异提示仑卡奈单抗长期获益或含安慰剂及选择偏倚。

drug.title: Volume change with gantenerumab: Impact of amyloid-related imaging abnormalities and amyloid removal.
drug.zh: 仑奈单抗所致脑容积减少主要源于淀粉样蛋白清除，而非ARIA。

drug.title: Real-world implementation of lecanemab in Korean patients at a tertiary memory clinic: Safety, ARIA risk, and early treatment patterns.
drug.zh: 韩国真实世界数据显示仑卡奈单抗输注反应常见但ARIA风险可控，早期治疗认知获益需进一步验证。

mech.title: From adolescence to Alzheimer's: a neurodevelopmental lifespan model of cognitive vulnerability.
mech.zh: 青少年期神经发育与遗传风险交互作用，塑造终身认知脆弱性及阿尔茨海默病轨迹。

mech.title: Isoserine Improves Spatial Memory and Remodels Synaptic and Inflammatory Gene-Expression Programs in APP/PS1 Mice.
mech.zh: 异丝氨酸改善APP/PS1小鼠空间记忆，并重塑突触与炎症相关基因表达。

mech.title: Decoding Synaptic Diversity: Molecular Architectures, Phase Transitions, and Shared Postsynaptic Failure in Alzheimer's and Parkinson's Disease.
mech.zh: 阿尔茨海默与帕金森病共享突触后域特异性崩塌的分子病理机制。

mech.title: Elucidating the neuropathological and molecular heterogeneity of amyloid beta and tau in Alzheimer's disease through machine learning and transcriptomic integration.
mech.zh: 机器学习整合转录组揭示Aβ与tau在AD中异质性神经病理及分子特征。

mech.title: Considerations for using amyloid-targeting therapies for the treatment of early symptomatic Alzheimer's disease.
mech.zh: 早期启动抗淀粉样蛋白疗法对早期症状性阿尔茨海默病优化疗效至关重要。

mech.title: APOE-guided lecanemab dosing dissociates ARIA-E from ARIA-H: The K-ROAD study.
mech.zh: APOE基因型指导仑卡奈单抗剂量可解离ARIA-E与ARIA-H，提示二者机制独立。

mech.title: Unraveling Neurodegeneration: Common Molecular Mechanisms and Novel Therapeutic Concepts in Major Neurodegenerative Disorders.
mech.zh: 五大神经退行性疾病共享神经炎症、氧化应激等核心机制，支持多靶点治疗策略。

mech.title: High reelin expression may explain why a subgroup of entorhinal cortex neurons functions as an initial nucleation site of Alzheimer's disease.
mech.zh: 内嗅皮层高表达reelin蛋白或解释其为何成为阿尔茨海默病起始位点。

dx.title: Multiplexed EDL-FET biosensor with tannic acid stabilization for simultaneous p-Tau217 and Aβ42/Aβ40 detection in plasma and whole blood from stroke patients.
dx.zh: 单宁酸稳定的八通道EDL-FET生物传感器可同时检测血浆及全血中p-Tau217与Aβ42/Aβ40，助力卒中患者AD早筛。

dx.title: Overview in Electrochemical and Electrical Biosensors for Determining Blood Protein Biomarkers of Alzheimer's Disease.
dx.zh: 血液蛋白标志物电化学生物传感器可实现AD早期无创筛查，替代有创高成本检测。

dx.title: Retinal microvascular alterations and glymphatic dysfunction mediate the association between APOE ε4 and cognitive decline in Alzheimer's disease.
dx.zh: APOE ε4通过视网膜微血管稀疏与类淋巴功能障碍介导认知衰退。

dx.title: Neuroimaging Epicenters as Vulnerable Nodes in Plasma p-tau217/Aβ42-Positive Alzheimer's Disease.
dx.zh: 血浆p-tau217/Aβ42阳性AD的神经变性“震中”锚定默认网络及边缘系统，并可通过网络脆弱指数实现个体化预后预测。

dx.title: Head-to-head comparison of plasma biomarker assays across platforms for amyloid pathology in a multicenter cohort.
dx.zh: 多中心头对头比较显示，含Aβ42的p-tau217血浆检测诊断淀粉样病变效能最优。

dx.title: Emerging diagnostic biomarkers and therapeutic targets in Alzheimer's disease.
dx.zh: 综述AD病理机制，聚焦新兴诊断标志物与治疗靶点及递送策略。

dx.title: Diagnostic value of blood p-tau subtypes in Alzheimer's disease progression and pathology: systematic review and meta-analysis.
dx.journal: European archives of psychiatry and clin
dx.zh: 血液p-tau亚型在AD进展及Aβ阳性诊断中价值各异，需按亚型分层解读。

dx.title: Beyond amyloid: Contributions of neuroinflammation, cerebrovascular disease, and neurodegeneration to memory impairment in the oldest-old, the LifeAfter90 Study.
dx.zh: 超90岁老人中，血浆GFAP升高经脑血管病与淀粉样蛋白共同致记忆衰退。

prev.title: Linking modifiable risk factors to vascular and neurodegenerative brain changes.
prev.zh: 累积血管风险负担与脑白质高信号及认知损害显著相关，并存在间接关联通路。

prev.title: Herpes Zoster Ophthalmicus and 3-Year Dementia Risk: Association and Modification by Prior Zoster Vaccination in a Large US Cohort.
prev.zh: 眼部带状疱疹使3年内痴呆风险增37%，接种疫苗可降低该风险。

prev.title: Chronic stress, social support, and domain-specific cognitive decline in HABS-HD.
prev.zh: 慢性应激加速女性及西班牙裔老人特定认知域衰退，社会支持或可缓冲。

prev.title: Cardiovascular-Kidney-Metabolic Syndrome in neurological and psychiatric disorders: a large multi-national cohort study.
prev.zh: 多国队列证实CKM综合征分期越高，痴呆、帕金森病及抑郁等神经精神疾病风险越大。

prev.title: Age at Menopause and Brain Atrophy Among Older Women.
prev.zh: 更早绝经与老年女性脑萎缩加速及认知衰退风险升高显著相关。

prev.title: Physical exercise for prevention of dementia study: a 48-month randomized controlled trial.
prev.zh: 48个月中高强度多模态运动未显著改善老年人MMSE评分。

prev.title: CNV-Finder: streamlining copy number variation discovery.
prev.zh: 基于LSTM的深度学习流程可大幅降低基因芯片CNV检测的假阳性率。

prev.title: Longitudinal effects of physical activity on sleep in association with hippocampal-amygdala subfield structure and functional connectivity in Alzheimer's disease.
prev.zh: 运动干预6个月可改善AD患者睡眠，且此效应与海马-杏仁核亚区结构及功能连接变化相关。

intro.title: Overview in Electrochemical and Electrical Biosensors for Determining Blood Protein Biomarkers of Alzheimer's Disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是用一滴血查几个关键蛋白，就能更早、更便宜地发现阿尔茨海默病，让普通人不用做腰穿和昂贵脑扫描。

intro.title: Microglia in Alzheimer's disease: Insights into disease progression and therapy.
intro.zh: 大脑里的清洁工（小胶质细胞）一旦吃错油、干不动活，就会加速老年痴呆，搞懂这点能帮咱们提前防病、看懂新药。

intro.title: Menopausal insomnia as a modifiable node of dementia risk: Mechanistic insights and intervention strategies.
intro.zh: 更年期睡不好可能增加痴呆风险，但这是可以提前干预的，这篇文章讲的就是怎么抓住这个关键期来护脑。

intro.title: Advances in the clinical application of mesenchymal stem cells for neurological disorders.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是用干细胞治疗老年痴呆等脑部疾病，目前看安全可行，但效果还在验证中，普通人了解个大概就行。

intro.title: Gantenerumab for Early Alzheimer's Disease: An Updated Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
intro.zh: 这药想清掉大脑里的垃圾蛋白来延缓痴呆，但新数据说效果一般，别指望它能治好，早发现早干预才是关键。

intro.title: Distinct roles of AMPA receptor subunits as potential therapeutic targets in Alzheimer's disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是大脑里负责记忆的“信号开关”出了问题会得老年痴呆，并介绍了未来可能修复这个开关的新药方向。

intro.title: Peroxynitrite: A potential therapeutic target for Alzheimer's disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是，一种叫“过氧亚硝酸盐”的坏分子会捣乱大脑，导致老年痴呆；看懂它，或许能帮我们找到延缓病情的新办法。

intro.title: Pharmacological Effects and Molecular Mechanisms of Lignans in the Treatment of Alzheimer's Disease.
intro.zh: 这文章讲的是，从植物里提取的某些天然成分，可能通过多种方式延缓老年痴呆，帮咱们普通人了解未来有啥预防思路。
